hero.name: Robert Stickler
hero.title: Software Engineer & Solution Architect
hero.description: I enjoy solving complex problems – both professionally and in my spare time. As a Software Engineer at Avanade Austria, I build solutions that automate processes and make teams more productive.

about.title: About Me
about.name: Robert
about.bio1: Programming is more than just a job for me – I also work on personal projects in my spare time, and throughout my studies I took every opportunity to code. My master's thesis was an AI project where I built a learning platform for students.
about.bio2: At Avanade Austria, I work at the intersection of technology and business. I don't just write code – I guide projects from initial requirements analysis to handover. Teamwork, mentoring, and direct client communication are part of my daily routine.

items.title: AI Learning Platform (Master's Thesis)
items.description: A platform where students can interact with texts using AI. Includes wrapper logic to prevent misuse, as well as metrics tracking to analyze usage.
highlights: AI-powered text interaction for students
Security wrapper to prevent AI misuse
Self-hosted web application
Usage metrics and analytics

items.title: Fee Note System
items.description: Complete digitalization of the fee note workflow for external contractors. From an Excel-based solution to a fully automated platform with a portal, automatic PDF generation, and approval workflows.
highlights: ~500 fee notes processed automatically per week
50 active users in the self-service portal
Comprehensive test suite in TypeScript and C#
Migrated from Excel to structured database

items.title: Mailjet-Dynamics Integration
items.description: Development of Azure WebJobs to replace Mailchimp with Mailjet. The integration enables control of email campaigns directly from Dynamics 365.
highlights: Bidirectional synchronization Dynamics ↔ Mailjet
Automated campaign control from CRM
Event-based processing via Azure WebJobs

items.title: Censhare Integration

highlights: REST API interface to Censhare CMS
Automated content synchronization
Data reconciliation between different systems
